title: Plant Manager – Commercial Laundry
text:
**Overview**

**Plant Manager – Commercial Laundry** 
**Premier Linen Services | Fort Myers, FL | Full-Time | $85,000 – $125,000 per year**

**About us** 
Premier Linen Services runs an advanced, state-of-the-art commercial laundry facility serving large and luxury hospitality properties across Florida. We’re a growing, owner-led company with a modern, high-volume plant, and we’re looking for a hands-on leader to keep it running safely and efficiently every day.

**About the role** 
The Plant Manager runs daily operations across our production facility. You’ll keep production moving through washing, drying, finishing and packaging, work with maintenance and logistics, and lead a team focused on quality, safety and on-time delivery.

What you’ll do

* Oversee day-to-day plant operations and make sure production goals are met
* Supervise and develop department supervisors, shift leads and production staff
* Carry out production plans, adjusting schedules and staffing to meet customer demand
* Watch real-time output, quality and downtime, and fix problems quickly
* Work with maintenance and logistics to keep equipment running and production uninterrupted
* Build a strong safety culture through inspections, training and quick action on hazards
* Help control labor, material and utility costs while keeping quality high
* Track and report KPIs for productivity, quality and safety to leadership
* Lead continuous improvement and lean initiatives on the plant floor

**What we’re looking for**

* 3–5+ years of experience as a plant manager, production manager or similar leader, preferably in commercial laundry, manufacturing or textiles
* Proven ability to lead and motivate teams in a fast-paced, high-volume environment
* Strong organizational, communication and problem-solving skills
* Calm and decisive under pressure, able to handle emergencies
* Comfortable with Microsoft Office and production software
* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s or bachelor’s degree preferred
* Fluent in English and Spanish (Preferred)

**Working conditions** 
This is a plant-floor role in an industrial laundry, with heat, humidity, noise and chemicals. It requires long periods of standing and walking, and the ability to lift and push up to 50 lbs. The schedule is flexible and based on production needs.

What we offer

* Salary of $85,000 – $125,000, based on experience
* Medical, dental and vision insurance
* A leadership role with a growing, owner-led company

***Premier Linen Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer.***

Pay: $85,000.00 - $125,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
